description: neuralese-direct-v2 (the unified base: 4962-document union, context 32768, shared 48-probe monitor, shared cadence) on BF16 Mellum2.1 with raw-token-v1 heads (maple.foundation_heads --profile raw-token-v1). Every difference from the base is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json (plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md). Backbone-inherent: the data binds the registered Mellum tokenizer twin of the union (neuralese-foundation-text-input-4962-mellum21-twin-20261011-v1: same ids, splits, source groups and records); grouped MoE kernel; Mellum's quantization component (from neuralese-direct-mellum-v1, gate taken over by the shared monitor); the measured base gate_pass on the 48 probes. Supersedes neuralese-direct-mellum-v2 (V9 data, 8192 context, 24-probe gate). History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

reference.source: BF16 Mellum2.1 (raw-token-v1 heads) on the 48 shared probes, 28/48 with the maple tool-call convention (runs/neuralese-direct-line-parity-20261011/mellum-base-gate-48.json texts, rescored mellum-base-gate-48-maple.json; plain math 10/12, tool 12/12, natlang test turn 5/12, open answer 1/12: answers run past the 256-token budget)

quantization.description: raw-recurrence-mellum-v11's precision points woven into the direct stage (owner rule: QAT in every stage), trained on the same SFT targets with no BF16 KL teacher (flagged, NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md). No preserve stream and no own gate: drift reference and behaviour gate are the shared monitor (in-run capture on the 48 probes), as on the LFM line.
